name: vimeo-mcp
description: Vimeo (social): me, read_comments, delete, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_vimeo_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_VIMEO_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_vimeo_access_token.description: Vimeo personal access token (developer.vimeo.com > My Apps > your app > Generate an access token, authenticated, scopes public private edit delete interact stats) or an OAuth authorization-code token; Vimeo access tokens do not expire unless revoked. Sent as 'Authorization: bearer <token>'.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /me returns the token's user {uri, name, link, account (plan), metadata.connections ...}.

tools.name: read_comments
tools.description: GET /videos/{video_id}/comments?page&per_page (`post_id` is the numeric video id) returns {total, page, per_page, paging, data[comment]}. A comment has no bare id field: `id` is its uri (/videos/{video_id}/comments/{comment_id}); replies are a separate connection (GET .../comments/{comment_id}/replies).

tools.name: delete
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: DELETE /videos/{video_id} permanently deletes the video (204; 403 when the token lacks the delete scope or does not own the video).

tools.name: analytics_post
tools.description: GET /videos/{video_id} filtered with fields= to the counts: stats.plays ('The current total number of times that the video has been played', may be null when hidden), comments and likes totals. `post_id` in the result is the video uri.
